passwordChangedSignIn: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
loginFailedGeneric: Login failed. Check your connection and try again.
accountLocked: Sign-in is temporarily limited. Try again shortly.
resetIntro: Enter your account's email address to get a single-use reset link. Your password stays unchanged until you open the link and choose a new one.
resetConfirmation: If an account with this address exists, a reset link has been emailed to it. Check your inbox. Your password is unchanged.
resetChooseIntro: Choose and confirm your new password. Completing this reset signs you out of every other session.
resetCompleted: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new link.
resetConfirmThrottled: Too many reset attempts. Try again in a minute.
resetThrottled: Password reset requests are temporarily limited. Try again shortly.
resetUnavailable: Password reset is not available on this deployment. Contact your administrator.
resetFailedGeneric: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
mfaExplainer: We emailed a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it to finish signing in.
mfaInvalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired. Sign in again to get a new one.
mfaTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
mfaUnavailable: Multi-factor sign-in is unavailable on this deployment. Contact your administrator.
